title_zh: 限定虚构条约展签的历史表述

scenario.label_zh: 限定虚构条约展签的历史表述
scenario.goal_zh: 核对条约涉及的群体与停战范围并约定改写展签的过度结论

context_zh: 学生设计虚构历史展览，手中资料由课程作者编写；并非对真实族群或条约作历史断言。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Pavel
sentences.text: The label says this treaty ended warfare throughout the region. Does our source support that?

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: Only partly. It says two tribal councils agreed to stop attacks on each other's settlements.

sentences.speaker: Pavel
sentences.text: And the next page describes fighting elsewhere five years later.

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: Then 'throughout the region' is much too broad.

sentences.speaker: Pavel
sentences.text: I'll name the two councils and say the agreement concerned their settlements.

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: Keep the note about the other fighting too. It shows the limit of the agreement.
